title: Information security policy documented and communicated
description: A written information security policy, approved by management, must be established and communicated to all internal and relevant external users. The policy must set out the objectives and scope of information security, management commitment, and the governance framework applicable to the cloud service.
remediation_hint: Draft and publish an information security policy with explicit management sign-off; establish an annual review cycle.

title: Information security roles and responsibilities defined
description: Roles and responsibilities for information security in the context of the cloud service must be clearly defined, documented, and communicated to all relevant staff.
remediation_hint: Document an RACI matrix for information security roles; publish it to all staff; update when organisational structure changes.

title: Risk management process established
description: A risk management process applicable to the cloud service must be established, documented, and operationalised. The process must include risk identification, analysis, evaluation, and treatment.
remediation_hint: Establish a risk register; assign ownership of each risk; review at least annually and after significant changes.

title: Security objectives aligned with business objectives
description: Information security objectives relevant to the cloud service must be documented and aligned with the overall business strategy. Objectives must be measurable and monitored.
remediation_hint: Define measurable security objectives; include them in management reporting; review progress at least quarterly.

title: Third-party and supplier security management policy
description: A policy and documented process for managing the security risks introduced by third parties and subcontractors must exist, covering selection, contracting, monitoring, and exit.
remediation_hint: Establish a supplier register; include security requirements in all contracts; conduct periodic compliance reviews.

title: Physical access control to data centre and server rooms
description: Physical access to facilities hosting the cloud service infrastructure must be restricted to authorised personnel via security zones and authenticated mechanisms.
remediation_hint: Implement card-based or biometric access control; maintain access logs; review access rights quarterly.

title: Environmental controls for data centre facilities
description: Facilities hosting the cloud service must be protected against environmental threats including fire, flood, extreme temperature, and power interruption.
remediation_hint: Verify fire suppression
column14: and UPS systems; review maintenance records annually.

title: Equipment disposal and reuse procedures
description: Procedures must exist for the secure disposal or reuse of storage media and equipment. All data must be securely erased or the media physically destroyed before disposal or reuse.
remediation_hint: Implement a secure media disposal process aligned to BSI TR-03138; maintain a disposal register.

title: Secure media handling and cabling protection
description: Removable media must be controlled and inventoried. Power and telecommunications cabling must be protected from interception and physical damage.
remediation_hint: Maintain a removable media register; enforce USB port restrictions; inspect cabling infrastructure annually.

title: Background verification for staff in sensitive roles
description: Background checks proportionate to role sensitivity must be conducted for all personnel with access to cloud service infrastructure, customer data, or security controls.
remediation_hint: Define screening requirements by role classification; conduct checks before granting access; maintain records.

title: Security awareness training programme
description: All personnel with access to the cloud service must receive security awareness training at onboarding and at regular intervals. Training must cover relevant threats, policies, and responsibilities.
remediation_hint: Implement a mandatory annual security awareness programme; track completion rates.

title: Disciplinary process for security policy violations
description: A documented disciplinary process must be in place for personnel who violate the information security policy.
remediation_hint: Document the disciplinary procedure in the HR policy; include security violation scenarios; ensure legal review.

title: Security obligations on employment termination or role change
description: Defined procedures must exist to manage information security obligations when employment is terminated or a role changes, covering equipment return, access revocation, and confidentiality.
remediation_hint: Implement a joiner/mover/leaver process with access revocation within 24 hours of departure.

title: Identity and access management policies
description: Policies and procedures for identity and access management of internal and external users have been documented, communicated, and applied, covering provisioning, de-provisioning, and least privilege.
remediation_hint: Document IAM policies covering provisioning and de-provisioning; enforce least privilege; publish to all staff.

title: Multi-factor authentication for privileged access
description: Multi-factor authentication must be enforced for all privileged access to cloud service infrastructure, management planes, and administrative interfaces.
remediation_hint: Enable MFA on all privileged accounts; enforce via identity provider policy; audit for exceptions monthly.

title: Access rights review and recertification
description: Access rights granted to users of the cloud service infrastructure must be formally reviewed and recertified at regular intervals.
remediation_hint: Conduct quarterly access recertification campaigns; automate revocation on non-response; document results.

title: Privileged access management and just-in-time access
description: Privileged access must be managed through a controlled process that limits standing privilege. Where feasible, just-in-time elevation must be applied and all privileged sessions logged.
remediation_hint: Deploy a privileged access management solution; implement session recording; enforce time-limited elevation.

title: Service account management
description: Service accounts used by applications or automated processes must be inventoried, assigned to a named owner, and subject to the same access control disciplines as human accounts.
remediation_hint: Maintain a service account register; assign owners; audit for unused or over-privileged accounts quarterly.

title: Joiners, movers, and leavers process for cloud access
description: A defined joiner/mover/leaver process must ensure cloud service access is granted on hire, adjusted on role change, and revoked on departure.
remediation_hint: Integrate HR system with identity provider; automate access revocation on departure.

title: Cryptography policies and key management
description: Policies and procedures for the use of cryptography and key management for the cloud service have been documented, communicated, and applied. Algorithms and key lengths must follow BSI TR-02102.
remediation_hint: Document a cryptography policy aligned to BSI TR-02102; enforce approved algorithms; review when TR-02102 is revised.

title: Encryption of data at rest for sensitive and personal data
description: Data classified as sensitive or containing personal data must be encrypted at rest using approved algorithms. Keys must be managed separately from the encrypted data.
remediation_hint: Enable encryption at rest for all sensitive storage; ensure keys are held in a managed key store separate from the data.

title: Key rotation and lifecycle management
description: Cryptographic keys must be rotated at defined intervals and on security events. Key rotation procedures must be documented and tested. Old keys must be retained only as long as needed.
remediation_hint: Configure automated key rotation; define rotation intervals per key type; test rotation procedures annually.

title: Certificate management and expiry monitoring
description: TLS/SSL certificates must be inventoried, their expiry monitored, and renewal carried out before expiry. Use of self-signed certificates in production must be justified and approved.
remediation_hint: Deploy certificate inventory monitoring with alerting 30 days before expiry; automate renewal where possible.

title: Network segmentation and zone architecture
description: The cloud service network must be segmented into security zones based on trust and sensitivity. Production systems must be separated from development and test environments.
remediation_hint: Define and implement network security zones; enforce zone boundaries with firewalls or security groups; document the architecture.

title: Firewall management and rule review process
description: Firewall and network access control rules must be managed through a change-controlled process, reviewed at defined intervals, and all-permit rules justified and approved.
remediation_hint: Conduct firewall rule reviews at least twice per year; automate detection of unused rules.

title: Remote access security
description: Remote access to the cloud service administration plane must use encrypted channels with MFA. Sessions must be logged. Access from unmanaged devices must be restricted.
remediation_hint: Enforce MFA for all remote access; log all sessions; block unmanaged device connections.

title: Endpoint protection and malware prevention
description: Endpoints and systems used to deliver the cloud service must be protected against malware. Malware protection must be current and cover real-time scanning. Detection events must be alerted.
remediation_hint: Deploy endpoint protection on all service-delivering systems; enforce automatic signature updates.

title: Change management process for cloud infrastructure
description: A formal change management process must govern all changes to cloud service infrastructure and configuration. Changes must be documented, reviewed, approved, and tested before production deployment.
remediation_hint: Implement a change management workflow with mandatory approval gates; enforce through the CI/CD pipeline.

title: Patch and vulnerability management
description: A systematic process for identifying, evaluating, and applying security patches must be in place. Vulnerability scanning must be conducted at regular intervals and critical patches applied within a defined timeframe.
remediation_hint: Establish patch SLAs by severity; automate patch deployment where possible; track exceptions.

title: Capacity and performance management
description: Capacity and performance of cloud service resources must be monitored and managed to ensure agreed service levels are met. Capacity planning must consider expected growth.
remediation_hint: Implement capacity monitoring dashboards with alerting at defined thresholds; conduct quarterly capacity reviews.

title: Asset management -- inventory of information assets
description: The cloud provider maintains a complete and current inventory of information assets relevant to the cloud service. The inventory must be reviewed and updated at defined intervals.
remediation_hint: Implement a CMDB covering all cloud service components; update on every infrastructure change; review completeness quarterly.

title: Security configuration baseline and hardening
description: Security configuration baselines must be defined and applied to all systems. Baselines must be based on recognised hardening standards. Deviations must be tracked and justified.
remediation_hint: Define hardening baselines per system type; enforce via IaC; run continuous compliance scanning and alert on drift.

title: Logging and monitoring strategy
description: A logging and monitoring strategy must be documented and implemented. Security-relevant events must be logged, protected from tampering, retained for a defined period, and reviewed.
remediation_hint: Define logging requirements; centralise logs in tamper-evident store; configure retention per regulatory requirements.

title: Business continuity plan covering cloud services
description: A business continuity plan applicable to the cloud service must be documented, approved, and tested at regular intervals, covering disruption scenarios and communication procedures.
remediation_hint: Author and maintain a cloud-specific BCP; test at least annually through a tabletop exercise.

title: Recovery time and recovery point objectives defined and tested
description: RTO and RPO for the cloud service must be defined based on business impact analysis. Actual recovery capability must be tested at regular intervals and results compared against objectives.
remediation_hint: Document RTO and RPO per service tier; conduct recovery tests at least annually.

title: Geographic redundancy and failover capability
description: Cloud service components supporting critical functions must be deployed across geographically separated locations. Failover mechanisms must be tested. Geographic distribution must not violate data residency requirements.
remediation_hint: Deploy across at least two availability zones; test failover annually; confirm data residency alignment.

title: Backup strategy and restore testing
description: A documented backup strategy must be in place. Backups must be performed at intervals aligned with defined RPOs. Restore procedures must be tested regularly. Backup copies must be stored in a separate location.
remediation_hint: Implement automated backup with offsite storage; test restores quarterly; document the schedule.

title: Security requirements in software procurement
description: Information security requirements must be identified and documented before procuring software components. Suppliers must demonstrate meeting requirements. Security clauses must be in procurement contracts.
remediation_hint: Define security acceptance criteria for procured software; include requirements in RFPs and contracts.

title: Secure software development lifecycle
description: A secure SDLC must be applied to all software developed for the cloud service. Threat modelling, security testing, and code review must be integrated from design through deployment.
remediation_hint: Document SSDLC practices including threat modelling; enforce via CI pipeline; train developers on secure coding.

title: Code review and security testing before release
description: All code changes must undergo review before production deployment. Security testing including SAST and DAST must be integrated into the release pipeline. Critical findings must block release.
remediation_hint: Gate releases on SAST scan completion; block critical findings; retain scan artefacts in the release record.

title: Vulnerability disclosure and responsible disclosure policy
description: A responsible disclosure policy must exist for the cloud service, defining how researchers can report vulnerabilities and how the provider will respond, including a commitment against legal action for good-faith reporters.
remediation_hint: Publish a responsible disclosure policy; define an internal triage process; track disclosed vulnerabilities to closure.

title: Incident response plan and team defined
description: A documented incident response plan must exist defining roles, responsibilities, communication paths, and escalation procedures. An IRT with named members must be identified and the plan tested regularly.
remediation_hint: Author and publish an incident response plan; identify and train the IRT; conduct a tabletop exercise at least annually.

title: Incident classification and escalation procedure
description: A classification scheme for security incidents must be defined and applied. Classification must drive escalation paths, response timeframes, and notification obligations.
remediation_hint: Define and publish an incident classification matrix; train all staff on the reporting path.

title: Notification to BSI for significant cloud security incidents
description: Significant security incidents must be reported to the BSI per applicable regulatory obligations. The process for determining notification obligations and the notification template must be documented and tested.
remediation_hint: Document incident reporting obligations to BSI; assign a notification owner; include BSI notification in IRP exercises.

title: Post-incident review and lessons learned
description: Following any significant security incident, a post-incident review must identify root cause, evaluate response effectiveness, and produce improvement actions with owners and target dates.
remediation_hint: Mandate post-incident reviews for P1 and P2 incidents; track improvement actions in the risk register.

title: Security event monitoring and alerting
description: Security-relevant events must be collected, correlated, and monitored. Alerting rules must detect known attack patterns and anomalous behaviour. Alerts must be routed to a team capable of triage and response.
remediation_hint: Deploy a SIEM or equivalent; define detection rules; assign on-call triage responsibilities.

title: Forensic capability and evidence preservation
description: The cloud service must maintain capability to collect and preserve forensic evidence. Log retention must support forensic investigation for at least the minimum regulatory period. Chain of custody must be documented.
remediation_hint: Define log retention periods; implement tamper-evident log storage; document evidence preservation procedures.

title: Threat intelligence integration
description: Threat intelligence relevant to the cloud service threat landscape must be gathered from reliable sources and integrated into monitoring and detection rules. Newly disclosed vulnerabilities must be assessed for applicability.
remediation_hint: Subscribe to BSI-CERT advisories; review and apply actionable intelligence within defined SLAs.

title: Legal and regulatory compliance register
description: A register of legal, regulatory, and contractual obligations applicable to the cloud service must be maintained, with assigned owners and at least annual review.
remediation_hint: Establish a compliance register; assign owners; review after regulatory changes.

title: Internal audit programme covering C5 criteria
description: An internal audit programme must exist that periodically assesses the cloud service against the C5 criteria. Audit plans, findings, and action tracking must be documented and reported to management.
remediation_hint: Define an annual audit plan covering C5 domains; track findings to closure; report results to management.

title: C5 attestation process management
description: A process for managing the C5 attestation engagement must be defined, covering auditor selection, evidence provision, finding tracking, and report publication.
remediation_hint: Establish an attestation project plan with milestone tracker; assign an attestation owner.

title: Data export capability and format documentation
description: The cloud service must provide customers with the capability to export their data in a documented, machine-readable format. Export capability must be tested. Proprietary lock-in must be disclosed.
remediation_hint: Document export formats and procedures; provide self-service export; test export completeness annually.

title: Service termination and data return or deletion
description: On service termination, customers must be able to retrieve all their data within a defined period. Customer data must be securely deleted after the retrieval window. A certificate of deletion must be available on request.
remediation_hint: Define and publish service termination procedures; implement secure deletion; issue deletion certificates.

title: Crisis communication plan for cloud service disruption
description: A crisis communication plan must exist covering significant cloud service disruptions, defining stakeholder notification procedures, communication channels, and spokesperson roles.
remediation_hint: Author a crisis communication plan; pre-define notification templates; include communication in BCP exercises.

title: Supplier dependency mapping and exit strategy
description: Dependencies on critical third-party suppliers must be mapped. Exit strategies for critical suppliers must be documented. Single points of failure in the supply chain must be identified and mitigated.
remediation_hint: Maintain a supplier dependency map; define exit criteria and transition plans; review annually.

title: Data security -- classification and protection
description: Data of the cloud customer is classified and protected according to its protection requirements for confidentiality, integrity, and availability. Classification criteria and protection measures must be documented.
remediation_hint: Define a data classification scheme; apply labels at creation or ingestion; enforce protection measures by tier.

title: Data residency controls and documentation
description: Geographic locations for customer data storage, processing, and transmission must be documented and controllable. Cross-border transfers must be disclosed and subject to legal transfer mechanisms.
remediation_hint: Document data residency locations; enforce via infrastructure policy; alert on violations; disclose cross-border transfers.

title: Data deletion and secure disposal
description: Customer data must be securely deleted at the end of the retention period, on customer request, or on service termination. Deletion must be irreversible and cover all copies.
remediation_hint: Implement automated retention enforcement; cover backups in the deletion workflow; issue deletion certificates.

title: Data processing agreement with subprocessors
description: Where subprocessors handle customer data, data processing agreements must be in place imposing obligations equivalent to those the provider carries to the customer. Subprocessors must be disclosed.
remediation_hint: Maintain an up-to-date subprocessor list; ensure DPAs are in place; notify customers before adding new subprocessors.

title: Privacy by design in cloud service architecture
description: Privacy requirements must be addressed from the earliest stages of cloud service design. Data minimisation, purpose limitation, and storage limitation must be incorporated. PIAs must be conducted for high-risk processing.
remediation_hint: Conduct privacy impact assessments for new processing; embed privacy review in the SSDLC design phase.

title: Data subject rights fulfilment process
description: Processes must exist to fulfil data subject rights including access, erasure, rectification, restriction, and portability. Requests must be handled within legally mandated timeframes.
remediation_hint: Define a data subject rights handling procedure; log all requests and responses; train customer-facing staff.

title: Encrypted transmission of data
description: Data transmitted over public networks must be protected using strong encryption and authenticated channels. Protocols and cipher suites must conform to BSI TR-02102.
remediation_hint: Enforce TLS 1.2+ on all public endpoints; disable weak cipher suites; scan for unencrypted paths quarterly.
